prompt: help me plan my weekend trip to yosemite
response: For a weekend trip to Yosemite, consider staying in the valley and exploring the surrounding trails. Start with a visit to Yosemite Falls and take the Mist Trail for stunning views. Head to Glacier Point for sunset and enjoy the panoramic vistas. Don't miss the chance to see El Capitan and the Valley Floor. With these highlights, you'll make the most of your visit.
